# esptool opening rfc2217://127.0.0.1:<port> through pyserial, and resetting the board into its
# bootloader, as the bytes on the socket.
#
# Written from pyserial 3.5's serial/rfc2217.py (Serial.open, _reconfigure_port,
# rfc2217_set_control, reset_input_buffer, reset_output_buffer) and esptool 4's reset.py
# (ClassicReset, whose _setRTS sends DTR again as a work-around for Windows' usbser.sys), not
# recorded: pyserial isn't installed where this was written.
#
# `>` the client sends, `<` the server answers (exactly, read in full before going on, as pyserial
# waits for each answer), `sleep` the client waits. Hex bytes; `#` starts a comment.

# The server asks for COM-PORT-OPTION both ways as the client connects.
< ff fb 2c  ff fd 2c

# Serial.open: DO ECHO, WILL SGA, DO SGA, DO COM-PORT, WILL COM-PORT. BINARY stays off, as pyserial
# asks for it neither way.
> ff fd 01  ff fb 03  ff fd 03  ff fd 2c  ff fb 2c
# WONT ECHO, DO SGA, WILL SGA; COM-PORT's DO and WILL answer the server's own requests.
< ff fc 01  ff fd 03  ff fb 03

# _reconfigure_port at pyserial's 9600 8N1: four SETs sent together, then their answers.
> ff fa 2c 01 00 00 25 80 ff f0
> ff fa 2c 02 08 ff f0
> ff fa 2c 03 01 ff f0
> ff fa 2c 04 01 ff f0
< ff fa 2c 65 00 00 25 80 ff f0  ff fa 2c 66 08 ff f0  ff fa 2c 67 01 ff f0  ff fa 2c 68 01 ff f0
# No flow control.
> ff fa 2c 05 01 ff f0
< ff fa 2c 69 01 ff f0
# DTR on, then RTS on: pyserial's open raises both lines itself.
> ff fa 2c 05 08 ff f0
< ff fa 2c 69 08 ff f0
> ff fa 2c 05 0b ff f0
< ff fa 2c 69 0b ff f0
# reset_input_buffer, reset_output_buffer.
> ff fa 2c 0c 01 ff f0
< ff fa 2c 70 01 ff f0
> ff fa 2c 0c 02 ff f0
< ff fa 2c 70 02 ff f0

# esptool sets 115200 baud: _reconfigure_port again.
> ff fa 2c 01 00 01 c2 00 ff f0
> ff fa 2c 02 08 ff f0
> ff fa 2c 03 01 ff f0
> ff fa 2c 04 01 ff f0
< ff fa 2c 65 00 01 c2 00 ff f0  ff fa 2c 66 08 ff f0  ff fa 2c 67 01 ff f0  ff fa 2c 68 01 ff f0
> ff fa 2c 05 01 ff f0
< ff fa 2c 69 01 ff f0

# ClassicReset: DTR off; RTS on, and DTR (off) again.
> ff fa 2c 05 09 ff f0
< ff fa 2c 69 09 ff f0
> ff fa 2c 05 0b ff f0
< ff fa 2c 69 0b ff f0
> ff fa 2c 05 09 ff f0
< ff fa 2c 69 09 ff f0
sleep 100ms
# DTR on; RTS off, and DTR (on) again.
> ff fa 2c 05 08 ff f0
< ff fa 2c 69 08 ff f0
> ff fa 2c 05 0c ff f0
< ff fa 2c 69 0c ff f0
> ff fa 2c 05 08 ff f0
< ff fa 2c 69 08 ff f0
# The first attempt's reset delay, then DTR off.
sleep 50ms
> ff fa 2c 05 09 ff f0
< ff fa 2c 69 09 ff f0

# flush_input and flushOutput, then the SLIP SYNC request.
> ff fa 2c 0c 01 ff f0
< ff fa 2c 70 01 ff f0
> ff fa 2c 0c 02 ff f0
< ff fa 2c 70 02 ff f0
> c0 00 08 24 00 00 00 00 00 07 07 12 20
> 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55 55
> c0
